seoul.prompt: Cinematic aerial drone shot at night over Seoul, South Korea: the Han River with illuminated bridges, dense high-rise apartment blocks and glowing skyscrapers stretching to the horizon, slow steady push forward, light haze, anamorphic lens, deep blue and amber color grade, subtle film grain. Sound: low ambient city hum, distant traffic.

fab.prompt: Inside a semiconductor fabrication cleanroom, an automated robotic arm lifts a silicon wafer that reflects rainbow interference patterns, amber safety lighting and cool blue LEDs, slow dolly-in macro shot, shallow depth of field, cinematic, high-tech, no people. Sound: humming machinery, soft mechanical whirr.

blackout.prompt: Static wide night shot of a dense Korean city of high-rise apartment towers with many lit windows; the windows switch off building by building in a wave sweeping across the skyline until the whole city is dark, ominous, cinematic, film grain. Sound: electrical hum that dies out into silence.

playground.prompt: An empty children's playground at dusk in a Korean apartment complex, a single swing still moving slowly back and forth in the wind, no people at all, long shadows, cold blue and faded orange light, slow push-in, melancholic, cinematic, film grain. Sound: wind and a softly creaking swing chain.

classroom.prompt: An empty elementary school classroom in Korea, small chairs stacked upside down on the desks, dust floating in shafts of late afternoon sunlight through the windows, a blank green chalkboard, slow lateral dolly, still, no people, cinematic, muted colors. Sound: a faint clock ticking, distant wind.

elderly.prompt: Back view of an elderly man with grey hair sitting alone on a bench on a nearly empty subway platform at night, his face not visible, cold fluorescent light, a train rushes past in motion blur, wide static shot, lonely, cinematic, muted teal color grade. Sound: train rumble and quiet station ambience.

newborn.prompt: Extreme close-up of a newborn baby's tiny hand gripping an adult's index finger, soft warm golden window light, gentle slow motion, shallow depth of field, tender and hopeful, cinematic. Sound: soft baby coo, quiet room tone.
